hits.name: OpenAI
hits.hook: Frontier models lose live internet during training
hits.text: Over the past several months, we have substantially hardened the security of our research training environment. We’ve removed live internet access for all frontier models during training and built an offline world for them to use instead—a cached version of the web where they can
hits.original: Over the past several months, we have substantially hardened the security of our research training environment. We’ve removed live internet access for all frontier models during training and built an offline world for them to use instead—a cached version of the web where they can
hits.draft_en:
OpenAI just removed live internet access from its frontier models during training.

If the lab building the models is locking things down, your tenant should be too.

3 checks for this week:

1. M365 admin center > Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access. Pick which publishers users can install from: Microsoft, your org, external.

2. Agent Registry. Block a risky agent and access is cut for current users until the maker resubmits a safer build.

3. Defender for Copilot Studio agents. Bad tool calls get shut down the instant they fire and your SOC gets alerted.

Which one have you actually turned on?
hits.video_tip: 20s screen recording: M365 admin center, click Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access, then Agent Registry > Block. Caption each click 1, 2, 3.

hits.text: You already have the data. Build a clearer view with Copilot Code.
hits.original: You already have the data. Build a clearer view with Copilot Code.
hits.draft_en:
Copilot Code is in public Frontier. Microsoft's pitch: "You already have the data."

My first-week plan:

Day 1: Check the Frontier controls in the M365 admin center. GitHub connections, business context, agent execution, automatic approvals.
Day 2: Pick ONE spreadsheet your team rebuilds every Monday.
Day 3: Ask Copilot Code to build a clearer view of it.
Day 4: Show your manager.
Day 5: Get asked to build 12 more.

Decide on automatic approvals on Day 1. Not Day 5.

drafts.text:
I ranked every way to build an agent in Microsoft 365. Only one gets S tier.

S: Copilot Studio. Four harnesses now, including the new Customer Conversation one.
A: Copilot Code. You already have the data, now it builds the view.
A: Copilot Cowork Projects. Instructions, context and outputs per project.
B: Agent Builder in Copilot Chat. Fastest path to grounded answers.
F: A Power Automate flow named "Copy of Copy of Approval v3".

Where would you move Cowork?
